description: Look up one product and return its ShopSavvy record: title, brand, model, MPN, barcode, Amazon ASIN and ShopSavvy ID (pass that ID to every follow-up tool), plus a link to its ShopSavvy page. Accepts a barcode (UPC/EAN/ISBN), ASIN, product URL, model number, ShopSavvy ID or a product name; barcodes, ASINs and URLs match most reliably, while a name can resolve to a different size or variant. Use product_search instead when you only have a keyword and want a list. Free without an API key; 1 credit with a key. If nothing is found, say that no data was found; do not guess.

identifier.description: Product identifier (barcode/UPC/EAN, ASIN, product URL, model number, product name, or ShopSavvy ID)

name: product_lookup
title: Look up a product
